summary: Turns styled text runs back into Markdown.
description: The inverse of [`convertMarkdownToRichText`](convertMarkdownToRichText.md): bold, italic and strikethrough become their markers again, a run carrying a link becomes `[text](url)`, and a run set in the theme's code font becomes a code span.

A code run carries no flag of its own — it is recognised by its font — so pass the same theme both ways and the pair round-trips. Runs are written one after another in the order given, without merging neighbours that share a style, so deeply nested formatting may come back expressed differently while reading the same.

params.runs: The runs to convert. An empty array gives an empty string.
params.theme: The theme the runs were styled with. Only the code font is read from it.

throws.IllegalArgumentException: no argument is passed, the value is not an array, or an element is not a run with text.

examples.title: Back to Markdown
examples.body:
```javascript
const runs = convertMarkdownToRichText("**bold** and `code`");

convertRichTextToMarkdown(runs); // => "**bold** and `code`"
```

examples.title: A link keeps its text styled
